bio.text: Tony Wied represents Wisconsin's 8th Congressional District in the U.S. House of Representatives, having run for the seat in the 2024 election.

He was raised in Green Bay, earned a bachelor's degree in business administration from St. Norbert College in 1998, and he and his wife operated Dino Stop gas stations and Little Caesars restaurants in Northeast Wisconsin before selling the businesses in 2022.
He lives in De Pere, Wisconsin.
